title: KS-61 (OpenAPI documentation gaps): demote from High to Medium?
bluf: The ticket calls itself a 'reminder ticket' with 'no urgency', best done per API as each is touched (ticket description). Counts, re-measured 2026-07-10 in the ticket: operationId missing on 316 of 316 operations, parameter descriptions missing on 183 of 183 (the 44.4% figure in the triage is Peter's older 2026-06-03 comment 1aa7b28d, now superseded). One real dependency: operationId is the blocker for KS-188 (High; ticket text), so demoting KS-61 alone leaves KS-188 as the carrier of that step. Priority is your field; the board seat changes it only on your word.

options.label: Demote to Medium; KS-188 carries the operationId step
options.detail: The board seat sets Medium. The dependency stays recorded in KS-188.

options.label: Keep High
options.detail: No change; a reminder ticket stays in the High count.

options.label: Demote and split out the operationId step as its own High ticket
options.detail: A seat files one ticket with the 316-operation count; one extra ticket.

default_action: After 48 h: b. Nothing changes; Wednesday re-asks you.
